auth.label: API Key
auth.description: DACHSER API key sent in the X-API-Key header. Create a portal login and apply for a production key at https://api-portal.dachser.com/bi.b2b.portal/api/information

actions.name: get_delivery_order_status
actions.description: Retrieve DACHSER delivery-order status using order references and filters.

deliveryOrderDate.description: The delivery order date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

acceptLanguage.description: An optional HTTP language preference for translated status descriptions, such as en-US or de-DE.

inputSchema.description: The filters used to find DACHSER delivery orders. At least one reference number, purchase order number, or delivery order date is required.

items.description: A delivery order and its status information returned by DACHSER.

deliveryOrders.description: The DACHSER delivery orders that matched the supplied filters.

outputSchema.description: The delivery-order response returned by DACHSER.

actions.name: get_shipment_history
actions.description: Retrieve the full DACHSER event history for shipments matching a tracking reference.

trackingNumber.description: A DACHSER shipment reference such as a consignment, customer order, delivery note, purchase order, SSCC, bill of lading, air waybill, container, invoice, batch, or packing-list number.

customerId.description: An optional DACHSER customer number filter; separate multiple values with commas.

acceptLanguage.description: An optional HTTP language preference for translated status descriptions, such as en-US or de-DE.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for finding DACHSER shipments by a tracking reference.

items.description: A shipment and its status information returned by DACHSER.

shipments.description: The DACHSER shipments that matched the tracking reference.

outputSchema.description: The shipment response returned by DACHSER.
